recent.text: So the #Titans have "wasted" a takeaway by turning around and giving it away twice as often as any team in the NFL.
recent.author: Paul Kuharsky
recent.quoted_text: The Titans lead the NFL in “givebacks” this season with 4. That’s 33.3% of their turnovers (tied-worst rate). That’s how many times they’ve generated a turnover, then turned it right back over—or gotten a safety—on the ensuing drive. No other team has done it more than twice.
